title: Psychoacoustics: Facts and Models (3rd edition)
authors: Hugo Fastl; Eberhard Zwicker
supports: 核对出版方公开内容简介、目录及第三版书目；支持学科范围与研究方向的概括。未访问付费章节，不用其书目支持具体实验数值。

title: Basic auditory processes involved in the analysis of speech sounds
authors: Brian C.J Moore
publication: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences, 363, (1493), 947-963
supports: 核对原文摘要及公开相关段落，作为言语与频率／时域处理框架；出版年用2008年卷期，网络先行发表为2007年。

title: Development and Current Status of the “Cambridge” Loudness Models
authors: Moore, B. C. J.
supports: 已阅读 Europe PMC 全文的模型结构、特定响度及听力损失模型章节：谱域求和、时间变化及响度重振；原作者模型综述。

title: Questions and controversies surrounding the perception and neural coding of pitch
authors: Oxenham, A. J.
supports: 已核对公开全文相关段落：位置、时域与相位锁定及联合模型的争议、缺失基频和谐波结构；尚无单一机制获得决定性支持，不把可用神经信息等同于可感知音高。

title: Derivation of auditory filter shapes from notched-noise data
authors: Glasberg, B. R. & Moore, B. C. J.
supports: 凹口噪声法、滤波器拟合及假设；ERB 经验式引用源已核对，正文细节待全文审阅。

title: Temporal modulation transfer functions based upon modulation thresholds
authors: Neal F. Viemeister
publication: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
supports: 噪声载波的调制检测阈与 TMTF；用于说明调制检测随速率和刺激条件变化，不能等同于包络编码硬截止。

title: The psychometric function: I. Fitting, sampling, and goodness of fit
authors: Felix A. Wichmann, N. Jeremy Hill
supports: 参照拟合、猜测与失误参数、采样及拟合优度；心理测量函数的统计框架，不代替具体测听规则。

title: Calculation of signal detection theory measures
authors: Harold Stanislaw; Natasha Todorov
supports: 已阅读公开原文的 yes/no、d′、c、ROC、不同任务与极端比例处理相关段落；正态等方差假设下区分敏感性与判据。文中教学例的数值另由脚本计算。

title: Transformed Up-Down Methods in Psychoacoustics
authors: H. Levitt
publication: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 49(2B), 467–477
supports: 2026-10-09 已阅读公开原文的基本假设、变换升降规则及估计章节；不同规则对应不同长期目标，有限试次及步长仍影响阈值估计。

title: PSYCHOACOUSTICS: a comprehensive MATLAB toolbox for auditory testing
authors: Alessandro Soranzo; Massimo Grassi
supports: 已阅读全文阈值、任务、刺激采样、staircase、PEST、MLP 与实验实现章节；用于经典范式及程序比较，不将工具默认参数视为普遍推荐。

title: Quest: A Bayesian adaptive psychometric method
authors: Andrew B. Watson; Denis G. Pelli
supports: 核对出版方原始摘要与书目；支持以当前 Bayesian 阈值估计选取刺激的程序思路，不据摘要描述完整实现或比较所有算法效率。

title: The psychometric function: II. Bootstrap-based confidence intervals and sampling
authors: Felix A. Wichmann; N. Jeremy Hill
supports: 已阅读公开原文的 bootstrap、阈值与斜率置信区间、采样布局及模型错配章节；区间需要相应模型与采样条件。

title: Painfree and accurate Bayesian estimation of psychometric functions for (potentially) overdispersed data
authors: Heiko H. Schütt; Stefan Harmeling; Jakob H. Macke; Felix A. Wichmann
supports: 已阅读原文的二项/Beta-二项模型、过度离散、状态非稳定与推断章节；适用框架不自动确定变异的感知或设备来源。

title: Chimaeric sounds reveal dichotomies in auditory perception
authors: Smith, Z. M., Delgutte, B. & Oxenham, A. J.
supports: 已核对原始摘要及公开图注，支持包络与精细结构重组的范式及任务依赖；全文 XML 获取失败，不声称逐段阅读全文。

title: Speech recognition with primarily temporal cues
authors: Shannon, R. V. et al.
supports: 以分频带时域包络调制噪声的经典语音识别研究；不据摘要扩展到所有材料或场景。

title: Web-based psychoacoustics: Hearing screening, infrastructure, and validation
authors: Brittany A. Mok; Vibha Viswanathan; Agudemu Borjigin; Ravinderjit Singh; Homeira Kafi; Hari M. Bharadwaj
supports: 已阅读作者公开 PDF 的刺激与环境限制、筛查、再邀请样本及经典任务验证章节；支持经过筛选和验证的在线任务作为补充，不等同临床测听或任意设备的绝对声级校准。

title: Headphone screening to facilitate web-based auditory experiments
authors: Kevin J. P. Woods; Max H. Siegel; James Traer; Josh H. McDermott
supports: 已阅读作者原文的反相三音任务、实验室播放方式验证与在线结果；用于耳机筛查逻辑，不将通过筛查视为声压校准或正常听力证明。

title: PSYCHOACOUSTICS-WEB: A free online tool for the estimation of auditory thresholds
authors: Massimo Grassi; Andrea Felline; Niccolò Orlandi; Mattia Toffanin; Gnana Prakash Goli; Hurcan Andrei Senyuva; Mauro Migliardi; Giulio Contemori
supports: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读原文的变换升降规则、六类预置任务、实验实现与讨论；介绍 2024 年论文中的工具与验证范围，不声称核对未来版本全部设备兼容性。

title: 7.2.4.1. Confidence intervals
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology; SEMATECH
supports: 已阅读官方方法文档的 Wilson 二项比例区间定义、上下限公式及术语说明；正文两组预设计数的区间另由脚本计算，不是文档实测数据。

title: Consonant identification using temporal fine structure and recovered envelope cues
authors: Jayaganesh Swaminathan, Charlotte M. Reed, Joseph G. Desloge, Louis D. Braida, Lorraine A. Delhorne
publication: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
supports: 正常听力辅音任务中 TFS 与再生包络的对照；说明处理顺序、听觉再滤波和训练必须考虑。
